description.en: The new description of the group.
The new name of the group.

descriptions.zh:
您可以根据需要修改用户组的`GroupName`和`Description`。

> 当启用SCIM同步后，不能修改SCIM同步的用户组信息。

本文将提供一个示例，修改用户组`g-00jqzghi2n3o5hkh****`的名称为`NewTestGroup`。
descriptions.en:
You can modify `GroupName` and `Description` for a group.

> If System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) synchronization is enabled, you cannot modify information about a group that is synchronized by using SCIM.

This topic provides an example on how to modify the name of the group `g-00jqzghi2n3o5hkh****` to `NewTestGroup`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso update-group --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --group-id g-00jqzghi2n3o5hkh0000 --new-group-name NewTestGroup --new-description This_is_a_group. --region cn-hangzhou
